jonof-l7pdemo.relevance: HIGH: the only known third-party Build engine binaries from Sep 1994 compiled with the same Watcom 9.5 CLIB as D3D.EXE. A 24-byte window probe finds 6.0% of D3D.EXE code windows verbatim in 75M.EXE, concentrated in the engine and CLIB regions (D3D obj1 ~0x38000-0x4ffff and 0x60000+), vs 1.2% for the Apr-94 Ken-Build GAME.EXE. Candidate oracle for Sep-94 engine/A.ASM/CLIB member shapes (identify functions by libscan-style comparison).

lesbird-whaven.license: Released 2006/2007 by former Capstone programmer Les Bird to the hobbyist community; no formal license, author states he does not own the rights (abandonware). Engine parts are Ken Silverman's Build (BUILDLIC). Page warns DAPI.DOC/DAPI.ZIP may contain viruses - not executed.
lesbird-whaven.build_date_evidence: SRC member dates 1994-11-20 .. 1996-05-05. Key OMF dependency stamps: GAME.OBJ (Capstone) GAME.C 1995-03-20 16:18, build.h 1995-03-10; Ken's BUILD.OBJ build.c 1995-07-10, build.h 1995-07-09 (time_t); CACHE1D.OBJ cache1d.c 1995-06-07; KDMENG.OBJ 1995-06-07; ENGINE.OBJ D:\engine.c 1995-07-09 17:24, build.h 1995-07-09, pragmas.h 1995-07-12 (DOS stamps, Watcom headers 1994-09-01); MULTI.OBJ 1995-09-02; BUILD.TXT changelog last entry 7/20/95
lesbird-whaven.compiler: Mixed: Ken's BUILD.OBJ/CACHE1D.OBJ/KDMENG.OBJ (Jun-Jul 1995) carry time_t dependency stamps = Watcom 9.5; Ken's ENGINE.OBJ of 1995-07-16 and all Capstone objects (GAME.OBJ 1995-03 onwards) carry DOS-format stamps with C:\WATCOM\H headers dated 1994-09-01 = Watcom 10.0a (contradicts Les Bird's recollection of 9.5 for the Capstone code). EXEs CLIB 1988-1994/1995.
lesbird-whaven.relevance: MEDIUM-HIGH: new (not previously held) Ken objects from Jun/Jul 1995 - ENGINE.OBJ 1995-07-16 (156725 B, 228 publics), BUILD.OBJ 1995-07-09, CACHE1D.OBJ 1995-06-15, A.OBJ 1995-06-15 - bracketing the buil1995 (Jun-95) ENGINE.C; pins Ken's 9.5 -> 10.0a switch to 1995-07-10..16 (so every Ken object up to mid-1995, including LameDuke's engine, is 9.5). GAME.OBJ (Mar-95, symbols) is a third-party Build game object 11 weeks after LameDuke.

lameduke-raynorpat.relevance: Behavioural (non-matching) C rebuild of LameDuke itself from IDA, Nov 2026, SDL2 port. Function comments cite IDA linear addresses (obj1 offset + 0x10000; 204/212 coincide with tools/funcmap.py starts); globals keep IDA names (dword_B56D8 = obj2:0x356d8). Use as semantic seed and naming aid for game/engine functions; never as matching evidence. build/map/raynorpat_functions.json maps obj1 addresses to its function names.

open-watcom-v2.relevance: Code generator source of the Watcom 11.0 lineage (descendant of the 9.5 compiler that built LameDuke): register allocator (regalloc.c, dataflo.c AllocBefore = the candidate-sort key derived from 9.5 traces), stack homes (temps.c), inlining, switch emission. Reference only; every rule verified against 9.5.
